text.text_excerpt: After all of my Middle Eastern food reviews I have been writing lately, a few people told me that I had to check out Lebanon's Cafe. Okay, twist my arm. I met a friend here and it was a pretty busy night, but he was able to grab a table outside. Normally I'm not a big fan of eating outside, but it was a nice evening so I went with it, We decided to start with some hummus as we looked over the menu. The hummus was perfect. It was creamy and whipped to perfection. I notice that a lot of places leave some lumps in it, but the hummus here was nice and smooth. For my entree I got the beef shawarma. Lebanon's Cafe really is one of the best Mediterranean joints here in New Orleans. The location is central and situated in an area with lots of food options, so it might not be hustlin' and bustlin' compared to its neighbors. Everytime I've been here it hasn't been too crowded, which I appreciate because you don't have to wait, the service is attentive, and you can get a really delicious and laid-back meal. All around a really great dining experience. I really like their vegetarian platter, so get that to share amongst your table if you still want some meat options. I love how Mediterranean food can bring the carnivores and veg-ites together in harmony. Between the gyro and baba ghanouj, there's something for everyone. On top of that, compared to our traditional Creole cuisine, it is downright healthy. Lebanon might be the best Mediterranean restaurant in the city. Everything I've ordered there has been great and the prices are very reasonable. 2 people can honestly walk out of here for under $25 with a doggie bag in hand. The hummus has great seasoning and is a meal in itself since they give you a generous portion with plenty of warm pitas. My personal favorite is the falafel sandwich (actually a wrap).
